criterios_praticos_para_escolher_uma_2c4: Practical criteria for choosing an online psychological care platform: video confidentiality, clinical records, patient experience, documents, billing, CFP and LGPD.
consultorio_online_para_psicologos_o_a23: Online office for psychologists: what to evaluate before choosing
uma_plataforma_de_atendimento_online_d89: An online care platform holds the most sensitive part of your work. These criteria help you compare options with a focus on confidentiality, clinical routine, and compliance.
desde_a_resolucao_cfp_n_0284f: Since CFP Resolution No. 9/2024, psychological care mediated by technology no longer requires prior registration in e-Psi. The central requirement is an active registration with the Regional Council. It remains the psychologist's responsibility to assess whether the remote format is appropriate for each case and to document that assessment. See the summary in the guide to the resolution.
pergunte_se_o_video_tem_13eab: Ask whether the video has end-to-end encryption. In this model, audio and video are encrypted in the browser before they leave and are only decrypted on the other participant's device. Many meeting tools encrypt only the path to the server, where the content can be opened. Also check whether there is recording and who would have access to it.
no_espaco_preludio_cada_quadro_78373: At Espaço Prelúdio, every audio and video frame is encrypted in the browser. The server only forwards data it cannot open, and sessions are not recorded.
o_registro_documental_e_obrigacao_657a6: Documentation is the psychologist's obligation and must be kept for the period required by the Council. Evaluate where the notes are stored, who can read them, and whether you can export them if you switch platforms. The relationship with the patient is yours, and the records should be too. Learn more in the guide to electronic records.
grande_parte_dos_pacientes_entra_2d352: Many patients join from their phones. Prefer platforms where the patient accesses a link, with no software to install and no mandatory sign-up. The video should adapt to unstable connections. For minors, check how the platform records the guardian's authorization.
o_consultorio_online_vai_alem_71c81: An online office goes beyond the video call. It includes a schedule with a booking link, reminders, receipts, certificates, reports, invoicing, and billing. Check whether these features are included or sold as separate modules.
confira_tambem_o_modelo_de_c9b69: Also check the billing model. Some platforms keep a percentage of each session. At Espaço Prelúdio there is no per-session commission: you set your own fee and get paid directly by the patient.
pela_lgpd_dados_de_saude_f531c: Under the LGPD, health data is sensitive personal data. Read the privacy policy, see which companies process the data, and whether there is a log of who accessed each piece of information. Be wary of generic security promises with no technical explanation.
